Old pic of Mt Shasta, CA

Picture taken in Weed, California, after the teepee burner was removed. The wooden structure, looks like a ramp, actually was a conveyor to take bark and saw dust to burn in a teepee burner. The lower building in the foreground was the green chain where sawn boards were separated and placed on wheeled carts to coast down the hill to the kilns and air dryers; pulling green chain was physically demanding work. The mill pond for log storage was behind all the buildings.

The original lumber company was Long Bell, later purchased by International Paper Co. Later everything got sold to Roseburg Lumber Company.

Abner Weed founded the city of Weed because the wind blew the hardest and most frequently there so his lumber would air dry faster. Weed is nicknamed the Windy City of Northern California. https://www.pinterest.com/pin/73746512622157589/
